description: A simple logger class (MessageLogger) that uses Android SharedPreferences to log messages with timestamps, retrieve all logged messages, and clear the log. It is intended for displaying messages in the UI rather than production logging.

classes.name: MessageLogger
classes.description: A utility class for logging messages with timestamps into Android SharedPreferences. Provides static methods for logging, retrieving, and clearing messages.

methods.name: logMessage
methods.description: Logs a message with the current date and time into SharedPreferences.

methods.name: getPrefs
methods.description: Retrieves the SharedPreferences instance used for message logging.

methods.name: getAllMessages
methods.description: Retrieves all logged messages as a single string.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the message log stored in SharedPreferences.
